p: Levites of the inheritance of their: Because they had no inheritance assigned them in the land of Canaan.
cities to dwell in: God would have them scattered through all the land, because the people might be preserved by them in the obedience of God and his Law.
two thousand cubits: So that in all were three thousand, and in the compass of these two thousand, they might plant and sow.
avenger: Meaning, from the next of the kindred, who ought to pursue the cause.
on this side Jordan: Among the Reubenites, Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, De 4:41.
smite him with an instrument of: Wittingly, and willingly.
stone: That is, with a big and dangerous stone: in Hebrew, with a stone of his hand.
revenger of blood according to these: That is, his next kinsman.
high priest: Under this figure is declared, that our sins could not be remitted, but by the death of the high Priest Jesus Christ.
slayer: By the sentence of the judge.
statute of judgment unto you throughout: A law to judge murders done either on purpose, or accidentally.
guilty of death: Who purposely committed murder.
cleansed of the blood that is: So God is mindful of the blood wrongfully shed, that he makes his dumb creatures demand vengeance of it.
